item.title: B2B Fulfillment Specialist
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
B2B Fulfillment Specialist

Home/

Job Description

You’ll own the day-to-day performance of a multi-node fulfillment operation—driving speed, accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency. You’ll turn data into decisions, coach leaders on the floor, and partner with Analytics, CX, and Engineering to keep OTIF high and exceptions low—especially during peaks. Location: Dallas, TX (On-site) Team: Operations Type: Full-time Reports to: Director of Fulfillment Direct reports: 4–6 Ops Leads (day & night), 60–120 hourly associates (seasonal flex)

What You’ll Do

Run daily operations across receiving, putaway, pick/pack, VAS/kitting, shipping, and returns.
Lead shift plans, labor modeling, and cross-training to hit service cutoffs (same-day, 2-day).
Hold daily Gemba/stand-ups; remove blockers and escalate risks before they hit SLAs.

What You’ll Bring

6–10+ years in high-volume fulfillment/3PL/eCommerce ops; 3+ years managing managers. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Hands-on CI toolkit: Lean, 5S, Kaizen, value-stream mapping (Green Belt nice to have). Carrier/transport basics (DIM, zones, surcharges) and packaging optimization. Excellent people leadership: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Ability to lift 25–30 lbs occasionally; comfortable on a warehouse floor (PPE required).

Apply for a vacancy

item.title: Customer Success Manager
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Customer Success Manager

Home/

Job Description

You’ll own the day-to-day performance of a multi-node fulfillment operation—driving speed, accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency. You’ll turn data into decisions, coach leaders on the floor, and partner with Analytics, CX, and Engineering to keep OTIF high and exceptions low—especially during peaks. Location: Dallas, TX (On-site) Team: Operations Type: Full-time Reports to: Director of Fulfillment Direct reports: 4–6 Ops Leads (day & night), 60–120 hourly associates (seasonal flex)

What You’ll Do

Run daily operations across receiving, putaway, pick/pack, VAS/kitting, shipping, and returns.
Lead shift plans, labor modeling, and cross-training to hit service cutoffs (same-day, 2-day).
Hold daily Gemba/stand-ups; remove blockers and escalate risks before they hit SLAs.

What You’ll Bring

6–10+ years in high-volume fulfillment/3PL/eCommerce ops; 3+ years managing managers. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Hands-on CI toolkit: Lean, 5S, Kaizen, value-stream mapping (Green Belt nice to have). Carrier/transport basics (DIM, zones, surcharges) and packaging optimization. Excellent people leadership: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Ability to lift 25–30 lbs occasionally; comfortable on a warehouse floor (PPE required).

Apply for a vacancy
item.excerpt:encoded: Own onboarding and quarterly reviews; turn logistics data into clear actions and measurable wins.

item.title: Integration Engineer
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Integration Engineer

Home/

Job Description

You’ll own the day-to-day performance of a multi-node fulfillment operation—driving speed, accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency. You’ll turn data into decisions, coach leaders on the floor, and partner with Analytics, CX, and Engineering to keep OTIF high and exceptions low—especially during peaks. Location: Dallas, TX (On-site) Team: Operations Type: Full-time Reports to: Director of Fulfillment Direct reports: 4–6 Ops Leads (day & night), 60–120 hourly associates (seasonal flex)

What You’ll Do

Run daily operations across receiving, putaway, pick/pack, VAS/kitting, shipping, and returns.
Lead shift plans, labor modeling, and cross-training to hit service cutoffs (same-day, 2-day).
Hold daily Gemba/stand-ups; remove blockers and escalate risks before they hit SLAs.

What You’ll Bring

6–10+ years in high-volume fulfillment/3PL/eCommerce ops; 3+ years managing managers. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Hands-on CI toolkit: Lean, 5S, Kaizen, value-stream mapping (Green Belt nice to have). Carrier/transport basics (DIM, zones, surcharges) and packaging optimization. Excellent people leadership: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Ability to lift 25–30 lbs occasionally; comfortable on a warehouse floor (PPE required).

Apply for a vacancy
item.excerpt:encoded: Build and maintain store, marketplace, and ERP integrations; design webhooks and mapping for orders/SKUs.

item.title: Logistics Analyst
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Logistics Analyst

Home/

Job Description

You’ll own the day-to-day performance of a multi-node fulfillment operation—driving speed, accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency. You’ll turn data into decisions, coach leaders on the floor, and partner with Analytics, CX, and Engineering to keep OTIF high and exceptions low—especially during peaks. Location: Dallas, TX (On-site) Team: Operations Type: Full-time Reports to: Director of Fulfillment Direct reports: 4–6 Ops Leads (day & night), 60–120 hourly associates (seasonal flex)

What You’ll Do

Run daily operations across receiving, putaway, pick/pack, VAS/kitting, shipping, and returns.
Lead shift plans, labor modeling, and cross-training to hit service cutoffs (same-day, 2-day).
Hold daily Gemba/stand-ups; remove blockers and escalate risks before they hit SLAs.

What You’ll Bring

6–10+ years in high-volume fulfillment/3PL/eCommerce ops; 3+ years managing managers. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Hands-on CI toolkit: Lean, 5S, Kaizen, value-stream mapping (Green Belt nice to have). Carrier/transport basics (DIM, zones, surcharges) and packaging optimization. Excellent people leadership: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Ability to lift 25–30 lbs occasionally; comfortable on a warehouse floor (PPE required).

Apply for a vacancy
item.excerpt:encoded: Analyze transit, surcharges, and carrier mix; recommend lane optimizations to cut cost per order.

item.title: Warehouse Supervisor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Warehouse Supervisor

Home/

Job Description

You’ll own the day-to-day performance of a multi-node fulfillment operation—driving speed, accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency. You’ll turn data into decisions, coach leaders on the floor, and partner with Analytics, CX, and Engineering to keep OTIF high and exceptions low—especially during peaks. Location: Dallas, TX (On-site) Team: Operations Type: Full-time Reports to: Director of Fulfillment Direct reports: 4–6 Ops Leads (day & night), 60–120 hourly associates (seasonal flex)

What You’ll Do

Run daily operations across receiving, putaway, pick/pack, VAS/kitting, shipping, and returns.
Lead shift plans, labor modeling, and cross-training to hit service cutoffs (same-day, 2-day).
Hold daily Gemba/stand-ups; remove blockers and escalate risks before they hit SLAs.

What You’ll Bring

6–10+ years in high-volume fulfillment/3PL/eCommerce ops; 3+ years managing managers. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Hands-on CI toolkit: Lean, 5S, Kaizen, value-stream mapping (Green Belt nice to have). Carrier/transport basics (DIM, zones, surcharges) and packaging optimization. Excellent people leadership: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Ability to lift 25–30 lbs occasionally; comfortable on a warehouse floor (PPE required).

Apply for a vacancy
item.excerpt:encoded: Lead 25–40 associates on pick/pack waves, safety, and quality for late cutoff SLAs.

item.title: Customer Success Manager
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Customer Success Manager

Home/

Job Description

You’ll own the day-to-day performance of a multi-node fulfillment operation—driving speed, accuracy, safety, and cost efficiency. You’ll turn data into decisions, coach leaders on the floor, and partner with Analytics, CX, and Engineering to keep OTIF high and exceptions low—especially during peaks. Location: Dallas, TX (On-site) Team: Operations Type: Full-time Reports to: Director of Fulfillment Direct reports: 4–6 Ops Leads (day & night), 60–120 hourly associates (seasonal flex)

What You’ll Do

Run daily operations across receiving, putaway, pick/pack, VAS/kitting, shipping, and returns.
Lead shift plans, labor modeling, and cross-training to hit service cutoffs (same-day, 2-day).
Hold daily Gemba/stand-ups; remove blockers and escalate risks before they hit SLAs.

What You’ll Bring

6–10+ years in high-volume fulfillment/3PL/eCommerce ops; 3+ years managing managers. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Proven peak management (2–10× spikes) and labor planning experience. Hands-on CI toolkit: Lean, 5S, Kaizen, value-stream mapping (Green Belt nice to have). Carrier/transport basics (DIM, zones, surcharges) and packaging optimization. Excellent people leadership: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution. Ability to lift 25–30 lbs occasionally; comfortable on a warehouse floor (PPE required).

Apply for a vacancy

item.content:encoded:
Smart Logistics Seamless Growth

Your Growth,

Our Logistics

Nationwide Reach,

Local Care

Get a Free Quote Explore Services Shipment Tracking Finding Warehouse



    chloe

    Our Services

    Solutions to Keep Your Business Moving

    01 Safe, Secure, and Scalable
    Warehousing & Storage
    Store your inventory in climate-controlled, strategically located warehouses for faster delivery and maximum security. 02 Pick, Pack & Ship - Simplified
    Order Fulfillment
    From receiving to packaging and shipping, we handle every step of your order fulfillment process with speed and accuracy. 03 Flexible Shipping Solutions
    Freight & Transportation
    Enjoy optimized shipping options, discounted carrier rates, and reliable transportation for domestic and international deliveries.

    Trusted By Top-tier Brands

    Our Mission

    “From day one, our mission was simple: turn complex supply chains into repeatable wins.”

    Liam Parker

    Founder & CEO, Apexus

    About Us

    At Apexus, we believe logistics should be the easiest part of your business

    With years of experience in third-party logistics, we provide end-to-end solutions that keep your supply chain running smoothly – from warehousing and order fulfillment to nationwide shipping and real-time tracking. Our mission is simple: to help businesses scale without limits.

    Learn More 10 +

    Years serving eCommerce brands

    Providing reliable logistics solutions for online businesses

    99 %

    On-Time order fulfillment rate

    We ensure thatevery single order leaves our warehouse on schedule

    Awards & Recognition

    Solutions to Keep Your Business Moving

    2025

    Best 3PL Provider

    For outstanding service, innovation, and customer satisfaction Logistics Excellence Awards 2024

    Top Supply Chain Innovator

    For implementing cutting-edge technology that streamlines fulfillment operations. Global Logistics Magazine 2025

    Sustainability in Logistics Award

    Reducing our carbon footprint through eco-friendly shipping practices. Green Transport Network 2024

    Customer Choice Award

    For exceptional reliability, communication, and on-time delivery performance. Apexus’s Clients

    How It Work

    From Setup To Shipping

    A dedicated success manager and clear milestones keep every step simple, transparent, and on schedule.

    Get Started 01
    Discovery & Quote
    Share SKUs, order volumes, and destinations. We tailor a fulfillment plan with transparent pricing and SLAs. 02
    Send Inventory In
    Ship stock to the nearest warehouse. We receive, QA, barcode, and slot everything for fast pick/pack. 03
    Pick, Pack, Ship
    Same-day fulfillment with carrier-optimized rates and optional branded packaging—B2C and B2B ready.

    Portfolio

    Real Results From Retailers and Brands

    NovaWear

    D2C Apparel Fulfillment Integrations

    HomeGlow

    Home Goods Retailer Fulfillment Retail Compliance

    GearUp

    Crowdfunding Mega Launch Customs Support Shipping

    FreshCrate

    Cold-Chain Snacks Cold Storage Route Optimization View All Case Studies

    Integration

    Connect Your Marketplaces and Back-Office Tools Easily

    Real-time Sync One-click Setup Secure Rest API

    Warehouse Map

    Our Worldwide Warehouse Network

    Mexico City Mexico Sao Paulo Brazil Accra Ghana Johannesburg South Africa Dubai UAE Hong Kong Hong Kong Singapore Singapore

    Pricing Plans

    Choose a Plan That Fits Your Needs

    Starter Plan

    For new or seasonal brands getting fulfillment off the ground. $ 1,500 /month Get Started
    • Monthly Orders: up to 500
    • Fulfillment Fee: from $3.20/order + $0.45/item
    • Receiving: $12/pallet (compliant ASN)
    • SLA: Ship same business day by 2pm cutoff
    • Integrations: Shopify, Woo, Amazon (core)
    • Support: Email within 1 business day

    Growth

    For new or seasonal brands getting fulfillment off the ground. $ 2,500 /month Get Started
    • Monthly Orders: 500–2,000
    • Fulfillment Fee: from $2.80/order + $0.35/item
    • Receiving: $10/pallet (compliant ASN)
    • SLA: Priority exception handling
    • Integrations: 50+ apps, returns portal included
    • Support: Success Manager (light)

    Enterprise Plan

    Custom program for complex catalogs, B2B, and global scale. Custom Contact Sale
    • Monthly Orders: 10,000+ or hybrid B2C/B2B
    • Fulfillment Fee: lane-based freight optimization
    • Receiving: Negotiated
    • SLA: Contracted OTIF, dock-to-stock ≤24h
    • Integrations: Shopify, Woo, Amazon (core)
    • Support: custom reporting & APIs

    Testimonials

    Don’t Just Take Our Word For It

    Evelyn Ross
    COO, NovaWear
    Luis Ortega
    VP Operations, HomeGlow
    Hana Park
    Supply Chain Lead, FreshCrate “Apexus didn’t just ship orders—they rebuilt our playbook. Within weeks, our pick/pack errors vanished and two-day delivery became the norm, even during drops. Their team flagged bottlenecks we didn’t see and automated the fixes. It feels like we hired an entire ops department overnight.” Read Case Study “We were juggling EDI compliance, store-ready cartons, and D2C orders across separate systems. Apexus unified everything under one SLA. Our chargebacks plummeted, store deliveries hit the window, and customer orders still left same-day. It’s calm, predictable logistics—finally.” Read Case Study “Cold chain is unforgiving. Apexus treated our SKUs with lab-level discipline—FEFO, lane monitoring, and airtight traceability. Waste dropped, excursions disappeared, and we expanded into two new regions with zero quality scares. They made ‘high stakes’ feel routine.” Read Case Study

    Blog

    Built for Your Industry

    5 mins read Fulfillment Strategy

    2-Day Delivery Without the Chaos: A Practical Playbook for Growing Brands

    12 mins read Reverse Logistics

    Returns That Retain: Turning RMAs into Repeat Customers

    8 mins read Inventory

    The Inventory Truth: Forecasting, Safety Stock, and What to Fix First

    15 mins read Cross-Border

    Cross-Border 101: Incoterms, Duties, and the Paperwork Brands Forget

    See More

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About Us

Home/

Trusted By Top-tier Brands

Our Mission

“From day one, our mission was simple: turn complex supply chains into repeatable wins.”

Liam Parker

Founder & CEO, Apexus

About Us

At Apexus, we believe logistics should be the easiest part of your business

With years of experience in third-party logistics, we provide end-to-end solutions that keep your supply chain running smoothly – from warehousing and order fulfillment to nationwide shipping and real-time tracking. Our mission is simple: to help businesses scale without limits.

Learn More 10 +

Years serving eCommerce brands

Providing reliable logistics solutions for online businesses

99 %

On-Time order fulfillment rate

We ensure thatevery single order leaves our warehouse on schedule

Awards & Recognition

Solutions to Keep Your Business Moving

2025

Best 3PL Provider

For outstanding service, innovation, and customer satisfaction Logistics Excellence Awards 2024

Top Supply Chain Innovator

For implementing cutting-edge technology that streamlines fulfillment operations. Global Logistics Magazine 2025

Sustainability in Logistics Award

Reducing our carbon footprint through eco-friendly shipping practices. Green Transport Network 2024

Customer Choice Award

For exceptional reliability, communication, and on-time delivery performance. Apexus’s Clients

How It Work

From Setup To Shipping

A dedicated success manager and clear milestones keep every step simple, transparent, and on schedule.

Get Started 01
Discovery & Quote
Share SKUs, order volumes, and destinations. We tailor a fulfillment plan with transparent pricing and SLAs. 02
Send Inventory In
Ship stock to the nearest warehouse. We receive, QA, barcode, and slot everything for fast pick/pack. 03
Pick, Pack, Ship
Same-day fulfillment with carrier-optimized rates and optional branded packaging—B2C and B2B ready.

Team Members

Meet Our Expert Team

Ava Martinez Founder & CEO Caleb Johnson Director of Operations Priya Desai Data Lead Jake Thompson Safety Manager

Testimonials

Don’t Just Take Our Word For It

Evelyn Ross
COO, NovaWear
Luis Ortega
VP Operations, HomeGlow
Hana Park
Supply Chain Lead, FreshCrate “Apexus didn’t just ship orders—they rebuilt our playbook. Within weeks, our pick/pack errors vanished and two-day delivery became the norm, even during drops. Their team flagged bottlenecks we didn’t see and automated the fixes. It feels like we hired an entire ops department overnight.” Read Case Study “We were juggling EDI compliance, store-ready cartons, and D2C orders across separate systems. Apexus unified everything under one SLA. Our chargebacks plummeted, store deliveries hit the window, and customer orders still left same-day. It’s calm, predictable logistics—finally.” Read Case Study “Cold chain is unforgiving. Apexus treated our SKUs with lab-level discipline—FEFO, lane monitoring, and airtight traceability. Waste dropped, excursions disappeared, and we expanded into two new regions with zero quality scares. They made ‘high stakes’ feel routine.” Read Case Study

item.content:encoded:
AGRICULTURAL LOGISTIC

Freshness Delivered Rural Trusted

Explore Services

From field to market with verified cold chain, gentle handling, and rural-route expertise – so your crops, livestock, and perishables arrive exactly as harvested.

[Services]

Move what farms grow and market need

We move what farms grow and markets need, with the right equipment for every load. More Detail 01 Crop Transport Crop Transport 02 Crop Transport Crop Transport 03 Crop Transport Crop Transport

[About Us]

We transport as if
we were farmers ourselves.

We combine logistics discipline with a farmer’s respect for every harvest.

[Operational Performance]

ON-TIME DELIVERIES

Measured across scheduled farm-gate pickups and DC drop-offs last season.

99.2 %
SHRINKS REDUCTION

Avg. spoilage reduction vs. non-reefer routes in pilot programs.

22 %
RURAL
ROUTES COVERED

Active lanes serving farms, co-ops, and local markets.

180 +

[Operational Performance]

Featured Cases

View All View Detail Farm-Gate Pickup Multi-Stop Consolidation

California Strawberries

Time-sensitive strawberry loads moved from field lots to Southern California retailers within 18 hours. View Detail Cold Chain for Produce Live Temperature Tracking

Wisconsin Dairy

Daily milk and yogurt distribution on fixed AM/PM schedules with temperature setpoint verification at departure and arrival. “During our avocado peak, they staged night pickups, pre-cooled the trailers, and shared live dashboards with our buyers. We kept temps within a half-degree end-to-end. Sell-through improved and claims dropped noticeably.” Elena Rodriguez, Sonoran Grove Produce “Our dairy routes run twice daily, and timing is everything. With fixed AM/PM schedules, arrival alerts, and POD uploads, our DCs plan labor better and reduce dwell. Chargebacks fell by a third in the first quarter.” Marcus Lee, Midwest Creamery

[Industry Served]

Farms Distributors Co-operatives

[Industry Served]

WORKING WITH FARMERS

Investirna agricultura

Join Now

[Process]

How We Work

Contact Us STEP 1
Plan & Book
Tell us what you’re moving and when. We map the fastest, freshest lane with the right equipment and capacity. STEP 2
Farm-Gate Pickup & Pre-Cool
We pre-cool reefers, stage pallets/bins, and load with low-impact handling to protect quality and animal welfare. STEP 3
Cold-Chain Transit & Tracking
Temperature sensors stream 24/7 to your dashboard; alerts trigger interventions before temps drift. STEP 4
Delivery, POD & Review
We hit your slot, capture proof-of-delivery, and send a post-trip report with temperature graphs and KPIs.

[Awards]

We Have Recognized

Best Cold Chain Provider 2025

American Cold Chain Institute

Rural Innovation Award 2025

National Ag Transport Association

Sustainability in Transport 2025

Green Freight Alliance

Humane Livestock Handling 2024

Livestock Transport Council

FreightTech Monitoring 2024

Logistics Technology Forum

Community Partner of the Year 2023

Farmers’ Co-op Network

1,000,000 Accident-Free Miles 2023

Highway Safety Board

Explore Our Press

item.title: Returns That Retain: Turning RMAs into Repeat Customers
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: The Inventory Truth: Forecasting, Safety Stock, and What to Fix First
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: Returns That Retain: Turning RMAs into Repeat Customers
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: 2-Day Delivery Without the Chaos: A Practical Playbook for Growing Brands
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: Returns That Retain: Turning RMAs into Repeat Customers
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: NovaWear
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
NovaWear

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: FreshCrate

item.content:encoded:
FreshCrate

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: HomeGlow
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
HomeGlow

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: NovaWear
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
NovaWear

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: FreshCrate
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
FreshCrate

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: GearUp
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
GearUp

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: HomeGlow
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
HomeGlow

Home/

Overview

NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Industry: D2C Apparel · Regions Served: US + Canada (expansion ready for UK/EU)

Engagement Length: 9 months (ongoing) · Annual Order Volume: 250k+ Primary Goals: Faster delivery, lower cost per order, and error reduction during drops

Challenges

Delivery Speed & Coverage: Single node created 4–6 day lanes for key inland markets; 2-day promise inconsistent. Launch-Day Volatility: Flash sales and influencer collabs produced 10–15× order spikes; manual batching collapsed under load. Rising CPO: Dimensional weight and suboptimal carrier mix increased cost per order. Quality Drift: Pick/pack errors during peaks and inconsistent branded insert logic.

Results (First 90 Days)

37% faster average delivery time (2-day became the norm for core markets). 98.9% on-time fulfillment rate, including promo spikes. 18% lower cost per order via carrier mix + DIM right-sizing. <0.5% error rate with scan-to-pack and QA at handoff. Return processing <24h, improving exchange/repurchase velocity.

item.title: Real-Time Visibility: Best Tools for End-to-End Supply Chain Tracking
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. item.title: Reverse Logistics: Turning Returns Into Revenue
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: The Future of Last-Mile Delivery: Drones, Robots, and Micro-Hubs
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: 4PL vs 3PL: Key Differences and When to Use Each
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick\/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility\u2014turning launch days from \u201call hands\u201d crises into routine operations.<\/p>","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"048","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":false},"_margin_mobile":{"unit":"px","top":"035","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"pxl_text_editor"}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: The Future of Cold Chain Logistics: Automation & Efficiency
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

item.title: Top 5 Tech Features to Look For in Modern Warehouses
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: Why Flexible Warehousing is the New Competitive Edge
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: Route Optimization for Rural Roads: Fewer Miles, Fresher Loads
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: How Cold Chain Integrity Protects Farm Margin in Peak Heat
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Returns don’t have to be a margin killer. With the right policy, portal UX, and warehouse workflow, RMAs can become a loyalty engine that increases LTV, reduces support load, and protects contribution margin.

Why Returns Matter (More Than You Think)

60–80% of returns are preventable (size/fit, expectation gaps, broken packaging). Customers with a great return experience are 2–3× more likely to repurchase. The goal isn’t “zero returns”—it’s fast, fair, and brand-positive returns that convert into exchanges and store credit. List Item #3

The 5-Part Framework for Retention-First Returns

Policy that builds trust

Clear window (e.g., 30 days from delivery), condition rules, what’s non-returnable. Offer free exchanges (same item/size) and bonus credit (+10%) for store credit vs. refund.

Frictionless Portal UX

No login wall; lookup by order # + email. Reason codes drive ops insight (size/fit, defect, color, changed mind, shipping damage). One-click options: Exchange, Store Credit, Refund (refund last).

Closed-Loop Logistics

Prepaid labels, drop-off points, paperless returns where supported. Consolidate inbound (regional hubs) to cut reverse freight by 15–25%.

Lifecycle Messaging & Save Offers

Automated flows: RMA created → in transit → received → resolved. Exchange nudges (“Instant exchange: ship new size today”), credit boosters (“+10% if you choose store credit”).

“The goal isn’t fewer returns—it’s faster, friendlier resolutions that turn returners into repeat customers.”

Evelyn Ross

COO, NovaWear NovaWear is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer apparel brand known for limited drops and seasonal collections. Before Apexus, they were fulfilling in-house from a single coastal warehouse, struggling with promo spikes, 2-day coverage gaps, and rising shipping costs. Apexus designed a multi-node fulfillment program, standardized pick/pack quality, and introduced real-time visibility—turning launch days from “all hands” crises into routine operations.

item.title: Services Detail
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Services Detail

Home/

Logistic Solutions

Warehousing & Storage Order Fulfillment Freight & Transportation

Our Services Brochure

Download Brochure Download PDF

Where can you find Apexus

Our Address
Apexus Inc. 1 Infinite Loop Cupertino, CA 95014 United States

E-mail Address
info@apexus.com

Phone Number
+123 – 456 – 789

Order Fulfillment, Done Right

Apexus provides end-to-end order fulfillment for D2C and B2B: real-time channel sync, fast receiving, accurate pick/pack, and carrier-optimized shipping. With multi-warehouse placement and live tracking, you’ll cut transit times, reduce costs, and keep CX consistent—at any scale.

Behind the scenes, barcode-driven processes, scan-to-pack verification, and carrier rate optimization ensure each parcel leaves on time with the right packaging and the best service level for its route. We support branded unboxing, kitting and assembly, inserts by segment, and returns with QA grading and restock logic—so CX stays consistent from first shipment to reverse logistics. Multi-warehouse inventory placement expands 2-day coverage, while smart batching, wave picking, and DIM right-sizing reduce both labor touches and shipping spend.

Key Benefits

Fast Fulfillment - Same-day processing cutoff with smart batching. Accuracy You Can Trust - Barcode flows, scan-to-pack, QA at handoff. Lower Shipping Spend - Carrier mix optimization and packaging right-sizing. Seamless Integrations - Shopify, Amazon, Woo, BigCommerce + 50+ apps.

What’s Included

Receiving & Putaway - ASN support, dock appointments, dock-to-stock SLAs. Pick & Pack - Wave/zone/batch picking; kitting, inserts, gift notes. Packaging - Branded unboxing, sustainable options, DIM optimization. Shipping - National + regional carriers, international labels, DDP/DDU workflows.

FAQs

What types of products can be stored and distributed? We handle a wide range of goods, including consumer products, electronics, apparel, and cold chain items. Hazardous materials may be restricted depending on regulations. Is insurance available? We handle a wide range of goods, including consumer products, electronics, apparel, and cold chain items. Hazardous materials may be restricted depending on regulations. What happens if a shipment is delayed? We handle a wide range of goods, including consumer products, electronics, apparel, and cold chain items. Hazardous materials may be restricted depending on regulations. Do facilities include temperature‑controlled storage? We handle a wide range of goods, including consumer products, electronics, apparel, and cold chain items. Hazardous materials may be restricted depending on regulations. How fast is onboarding? We handle a wide range of goods, including consumer products, electronics, apparel, and cold chain items. Hazardous materials may be restricted depending on regulations.
